verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own MCP server exposes a substantial programmatic surface over the account. It covers inspecting workflows, tools and integrations; building, editing and deploying workflows; diagnosing tickets; auditing knowledge bases; testing tools; and running simulations. Nothing documents a general REST API or claims parity with the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, a documented general-purpose REST/HTTP API, programmatic coverage of Coach QA scoring, analytics, outbound campaigns, guardrail and integration configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Lorikeet MCP server lets you interact with your Lorikeet account directly from Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Codex.
Explore your setup - inspect workflows, tools, and integrations
Build, edit, and deploy workflows using natural language
Run simulations - test workflows against different customer scenarios
Talk to Coach wherever you work, whether in Lorikeet, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, or via MCP.
